A source sampling interval >=0.20 s combined with a strict maximum age 0.20 s leaves no delay slack near sampling boundaries. Floating legacy sampling may select 0.25 s gaps at a 20 Hz scan rate. These intervals must stop or fail existing gates, not be hidden by relaxing the ceiling.
Synchronized bootstrap waits six actual rows and may shift warmup timing. Pair as an explicit input-contract factor with unchanged legacy control, not as a guaranteed no-effect fix.
Command serialization and 5 ms ROS timer can affect timing. Report actual callback/candidate latency and wait distributions in live pairing.
Clock reset latches fail-closed state and reports it. The inherited ROS rate/episode loop may require the external wall-time runner to terminate after a reset.
This node cannot veto independently published move_base commands. A common sensor-staleness relay needs separately designed and fairly reassessed M06 or engineering-chain work.
Queue drops/expired scans may recover to fresh history, but remain terminal evidence failures in the episode report. There is no loss concealment.
